reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text (p0078 Supplemental Payments revenue share; p0155 entire agreement) contains no most-favoured-nation, 'no less favorable', or price-matching mechanic burdening Licensee, so the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is met.
The rationale correctly distinguishes a fixed 33% profit share on defined third-party revenue from an obligation to extend Licensor the best terms given to third parties, so the rule is not engaged.
No Vendor-granted MFN exists that would need preserving; nothing to redline and no over-flagging risk.
